summary: For the challenge Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment on the Moon and Mars, Team Blue.Star created "A Journey That Never Truly Ended", a interactive video that targets people who are keen on learning more about the wonderful space roaming vehicles- explaining the topic of the two robots "Lunar Roving Vehicle" and "Opportunity" in a simple yet engaging format.
details:
Can little rovers explore another planet?

Yes, you heard that right! Space rovers such as "Lunar Roving Vehicle" and "Opportunity" were being sent to other planets or the Moon to explore the history behind them.

Our topic, Space Roaming Vehicles, because it was a topic that generally interested our team. We believed that other people should also learn and appreciate the Lunar Roving Vehicle and Opportunity, and their scientific legacies and importance.

Lunar Roving Vehicle was a helpful robot during the Apollo 15, yet it still had to be left behind on the moon. As for Opportunity, a robot that discovered many new aspect of Mars but due to something uncontrollable had to be left on Mars.

We used Capcut for editing and Nasa images. Us as a team divided the work equally. Our team leader Almira came up with the idea and wrote the story line and our teammate Ayse did the editing and image research. Both teammates filmed their parts of the story and explained the stories with their own words, trying to make it as interactive as possible.
